subject: math
cluster: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties

items.prompt: A square is a special kind of rectangle. Why?

steps: A rectangle has $4$ right angles and opposite sides equal.
A square has all those attributes plus all sides equal, so every square is a rectangle.
solution.answer: A square has all a rectangle's attributes (and more)

steps: A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides.
A rectangle also has two pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram.
solution.answer: A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides, like all parallelograms

items.prompt: If all squares are rhombuses, what attribute do they share?

steps: A rhombus has all four sides equal.
A square also has all sides equal, so it is a rhombus.
A square needs all sides equal, but a rectangle may have longer and shorter sides.
So not every rectangle is a square.

items.prompt: All squares, rectangles, and rhombuses are what larger category?

steps: So they are all quadrilaterals (and parallelograms).

items.prompt: A property true of all rectangles is also true of squares. Why?

steps: A square is a type of rectangle.
So it inherits every attribute that all rectangles have.
solution.answer: Because a square is a kind of rectangle
